description: The tuning wizard records table-layout tuning types (PARTITIONING, CLUSTERING, DISTRIBUTION, SORTING) through UnifiedTuningConfiguration.enable_platform_optimization, which only handles platform optimizations (Z-ordering, liquid clustering, auto optimize/compact, bloom filters, materialized views) and silently ignores the table-layout types. The wizard prints success messages (e.g. Snowflake clustering keys, BigQuery partitioning, Redshift distribution/sort keys) but the resulting config carries none of them. Found by rewriting the wizard tests against real UnifiedTuningConfiguration objects: the previous _DummyConfig stand-in accepted every type, masking the gap. Affected sites: _run_simple_wizard (snowflake/bigquery/redshift branches), _run_advanced_wizard platform paths, _apply_defaults_to_config non-interactive defaults, and all _configure_*_optimizations except Databricks. Fix direction: route table-layout types to table_tunings entries (or extend enable_platform_optimization) so confirmed choices persist, with tests asserting presence.
